info.name: Electronics Store API
info.description:
CIT4040 course project. Import this collection and the environment, then run the **Auth** folder first, then any other folder (or run the whole collection in order). Only `baseUrl` may need editing.

Every request has a test asserting its status code. Requests named `FAIL ...` are deliberate failures (validation, not found, forbidden) and assert the expected error status and the standard error body.
